text:
clare: Heads-up: i'm landing a docs PR to clarify per-variant ceilings and add compact migration snippets for the model-catalog cards. Need a small compatibility blurb, CLI+SDK examples, and a tiny benchmark footnote. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/5007
hugo: Thanks. Do we have final numbers for max_sequence_length per variant? We should avoid claiming a single global limit.
maya: Runtime sent numbers: atlas7b(fp16)=8192, atlas7b-quant=6144, ember4b(fp16)=6144, ember4b-quant=4096. They asked us to prefix with "variant-dependent" and link to /data/model-catalog.csv for the exact mapping.
clare: Good. i'll rename all examples to use `max_sequence_length` (we standardized this key). Also i'll convert the inline HTML table into a generated include that pulls from the CSV so it stays up-to-date.
runtime-bot: Note: kernel selection may change effective ceilings by +/- 256 tokens on some GPU families. Recommend wording: "effective ceilings may vary slightly by GPU family and kernel selection." hugo: let's add that exact sentence under compatibility.
clare: i'll add a short benchmark row comparing q4_0 vs fp16 at batch sizes 1/4/16 and add a footnote "results vary by GPU family and kernel selection". keep the table tiny.
maya: Ops flagged a customer with pinned `ember4b-legacy` aliases. Ops request: display a deprecation banner behind a feature-flag and don't flip it until ops confirms pinned instances are cleared.
ops-lead: Confirmed. docs can show the scheduled deprecation note, but hold the banner flip until we clear pinned reservations. Target: next maintenance window Thursday EOD.
clare: i'll include the banner as a feature-flagged TODO in the PR and set the flip date to the Thursday window. thanks.
hugo: For snippets, prefer showing resolveVariant + a short graceful fallback to compat alias. Make the SDK example 6 lines max so it fits the model card sidebar.
clare: snippet draft (SDK v4) — keeping it compact:\n```js\n// SDK v4 compact: prefer quant, graceful fallback
const v = await client.models.resolveVariant('atlas7b', {preferQuantized:true});
try { const r = await client.generate({model:v, input:prompt}); console.log(r.generated_text); }
catch(e) { const r = await client.generate({model:'atlas7b-compat-q4_0', input:prompt}); console.log(r.generated_text); }
```\nmaya: add a one-line curl CLI example too for quick repro in support tickets: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"atlas7b:compat-q4_0","input":"..."}'`
clare: also adding an embeddings snippet showing shard hint: `client.embed({model: variant, input: texts, shardHint: 4})` with a one-line note about shard sizing for large corpora.
hugo: tiny editorial: change any `sequence_limit` keys to `max_sequence_length` in YAML frontmatter and examples; remove trailing commas in JSON blocks.
docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.io/pr-5007 (CI #12180) :white_check_mark:
clare: i'll also add a footnote linking to the model-catalog CSV and a TODO for automation to regenerate the generated HTML table from CSV. merging plan: small edits now, wait for ops to clear pinned aliases, then flip the banner in Thursday maintenance window. i'll ping here once ops confirms.
ops-lead: i'll report back by Wednesday EOD if anything changes. thanks all!
